Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing carries no validated forward edge — only the drawdown-control discipline would have mattered, and it does not work here. Past calls under this setup have had poor directional accuracy (0.368), so conviction should be low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (unscorable, durability 0.91) hands off confirmed leadership to Industrial Metals via sustained relative outperformance in 512400.SS versus the CSI 300 over the next two weeks; retire this watch if Industrial Metals fails to hold above Gold Miners' relative momentum for 5 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the strongest SCORABLE eligible theme (rank 2, eligible, decent durability 0.72 under the trend gate). Its breadth (0.846) is broad relative to the eligible universe and it is not crowded (z -0.13), so momentum concentration and participation suggest ongoing relative leadership within an otherwise narrow tape. This is a relative-lean expressed through the proxy 512400.SS, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Trend gate did_NOT_hold in A-shares historically, and the scanner's own track record shows only 37% directional accuracy; this breadth/durability read is coincident and may simply mark a late-stage move in an unstable tape.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% or more before 2026-10-09

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics screens as mean-reverting (hurst mean-revert) with low durability (0.42) and very narrow breadth (0.294) despite a high rank (3). Within a mean-reverting regime where the trend gate has failed historically, a momentum rank in a mean-revert / low-breadth state argues against chasing the theme as relative strength; it reads as an attention spike rather than durable trend leadership.
evidence: crowding_z -0.56 (not yet crowded / no reflexivity cap)

falsifier.text: 515000.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% or more before 2026-09-29

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is the only scorable eligible theme flagged crowded (z 1.15, crowded=true). Crowding here is a size-down caution only — never a short — but combined with mediocre durability (0.52) and narrow breadth (0.357), it supports avoiding new capital allocation to this theme; there is no confirmed handoff into it and no validated forward edge to justify relative overweight.
theses.dissent: Crowding does not predict crash or revert in a diversified basket; within a mean-reverting tape, an already-crowded incumbent can continue to lead, so avoid is conservative relative positioning, not a directional call against the theme.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% or more before 2026-10-09
